name: markdown-stylesheets
description: Provides custom Markdown preview and export styling with a fixed-width centered layout, horizontally scrollable tables, blockquotes, and code blocks with a copy-to-clipboard button, plus switchable GitHub and VS Code themes.

enumDescriptions: Follow the active VS Code color theme automatically (clears managed entries from 'markdown.styles').
Force VS Code Light 2026 (#FFFFFF background, #202020 text) in both Markdown Preview and .htmd exports.
Force VS Code Dark 2026 (#121314 background, #BBBEBF text) in both Markdown Preview and .htmd exports.
Force GitHub Light Default (#FFFFFF background, #1F2328 text) in both Markdown Preview and .htmd exports.
Force GitHub Dark Default (#0D1117 background, #F0F6FC text) in both Markdown Preview and .htmd exports.
markdown-stylesheets.theme.description: Select the Markdown stylesheet theme for VS Code's built-in Markdown Preview and .htmd exports. Automatically updates 'markdown.styles' with the resolved extension path.
